method.name: HH+HV joint darkening, scene-relative thresholds (flood_detection_v2)
method.notes: Baseline: HH drop >= 3 dB and HV drop >= 1.5 dB; tested HH/HV pairs (2,0.5), (3,1.5), (4,2.5). Min 9 connected pixels; polygons shown are areas >= 25 pixels (0.09 km2).

validation.reference: Copernicus EMSR857 AOI11 Grading Monitoring 1, observedEventA
validation.agreement: Exploratory spatial agreement only; NOT validated accuracy
notes: 10-day mismatch between acquisition dates prevents accuracy claims
Only common, analyzed AOI and valid NISAR pixels included
Copernicus Flood trace excluded; only Flooded area included
NISAR BETA change candidates are unvalidated

limitations: NISAR GCOV BETA data not yet independently radiometrically validated for this use
Low radar backscatter can reflect non-flood surface changes
HH+HV joint darkening may miss vegetation-covered inundation
All thresholds are heuristic and scene-relative
No independent ground/optical flood reference has been used yet
Smart Doubt is threshold sensitivity, NOT a calibrated probability or model confidence
